rungs.title: HR Coordinator
rungs.summary: Learning the employee life cycle and the records behind it.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the policies, contracts and the HR systems.
rungs.delivery: Runs onboarding, records and routine requests accurately.
rungs.leadership: Handles confidential matters with discretion and care.

rungs.title: HR Advisor
rungs.summary: Advises managers and employees on people matters.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in employment practice, performance, absence and recruitment.
rungs.delivery: Resolves people cases and runs recruitment and onboarding well.
rungs.leadership: Is trusted by employees and managers because they act fairly.

rungs.title: HR Manager
rungs.summary: Owns people practice for a part of the company.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in employment law, reward and development; uses data to see problems early.
rungs.delivery: Owns people processes, case outcomes and the quality of hiring.
rungs.leadership: Coaches managers through hard conversations and leads HR projects.

rungs.title: Head of People
rungs.summary: Owns people strategy, culture and capability.
rungs.knowledge: Connects workforce, culture and capability to strategy and cost.
rungs.delivery: Owns people strategy, reward, hiring plan and culture outcomes.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and advises the CEO on how the company treats its people.
